title: Brunch Thyme at Alba Thermal Springs & Spa
summary: Start the day with a one-course breakfast and choice of beverage in restaurant Thyme, followed by a soak in the hot springs. Available every day during winter. Booking required.
accessibilityNotes: Alba is fully accessible; contact venue for specific requirements
weatherDependency: Hot springs and indoor restaurant - the cold makes it better, not worse
nearbyAttractions: Cape Schanck Lighthouse; Peppers Moonah Links; Flinders Hotel
suggestedItineraryPairing: Brunch at Thyme, then a long soak. Drive to Flinders for a walk on the pier afterwards, or call it a day - that's a full day already.
editorVerdict: Hot springs in winter is one of the Peninsula's signature moves. Adding breakfast in front of it is a very sensible upgrade.
editorNote:
Alba Thermal Springs is running a winter brunch package through their restaurant Thyme - one-course breakfast and a drink, then you're into the hot springs for the session. The package covers both. Check current pricing with Alba directly.

The logic here is obvious: it's winter, you want to be warm, and getting into a thermal pool after a proper breakfast is significantly better than doing it on an empty stomach.

Book well in advance for weekends - Alba fills out. Weekdays are more available and the experience is the same without the crowds.
